newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU moves to protect quality of transfusion blood.
newsitem.headline: EU moves to protect quality of transfusion blood.

text.p: The European Union took steps on Friday to draw up a common approach among its 15 member states to guarantee the quality of transfusion blood.

Irish health minister Michael Noonan, in a statement issued on behalf of the bloc after a conference of experts, said member states had agreed on the need to achieve consistency in all elements of the blood transfusion chain.
He said the mobility of people throughout the EU area and the increasing demand for plasma-derived products meant there had to be common measures applied in selecting blood donors and treating blood.
This was necessary to reduce the spread of disease, the statement said.
